item.title: Hilton takes the helm at onsen resort in Vietnam’s Quang Hanh
item.description: Global hospitality group Hilton has announced the opening of Hilton Quang Hanh Onsen Resort, a property nestled in the Quang Hanh valley in Cam Pha, Vietnam. The property marks Hilton’s first onsen resort in Southeast Asia and the third property under the Hilton Hotels & Resorts brand in Vietnam. The property is owned by Vietnamese developer Sun Group, which had operated the resort as Yoko Onsen Quang Hanh since its completion in 2020. item.title: China broadens REIT market to embrace commercial real estate
item.description: China’s REIT market is expanding to include a broader scope of commercial properties. On Dec 31 last year, the China Securities Regulatory Commission announced the launch of a pilot programme for commercial property REITs, which can include office, hotel, retail and mixed-use properties as its underlying assets. item.title: Trust-based property purchases: A high-stakes legacy strategy
item.description: Buying residential properties via a trust in Singapore is one of the most binding financial commitments a parent can make for their child. At stake may be millions in property value, the child's future housing options and family relationships spanning decades. Since the additional buyer's stamp duty (ABSD) for trust purchases rose from 35% to 65% in April 2023, the landscape has fundamentally shifted. item.title: APAC Realty posts higher real estate brokerage fees from new launches in 2025
item.description: Property agency ERA Singapore saw brisk business in the new private housing market in 2025, with the company appointed as a marketing agent for 27 new launches last year, comprising 12,773 units. The healthy roster of launches bolstered new private home sales in 2025, with developers selling 12,445 units, including executive condos (ECs), representing a 61.7% jump y-o-y. item.title: Offices back on the radar for Apac real estate investors: CBRE
item.description: The office property market is back on the radar for Asia Pacific (Apac) real estate investors, according to research by CBRE. In its 2026 Asia Pacific Real Estate Market Outlook report, the firm highlights that respondents to its latest Apac investor intentions survey chose offices as their most preferred sector. item.title: Hotel at Lorong 12 Geylang back on the market at lower price of $110 mil
item.description: A 184-key hotel at 12 Lorong 12 Geylang has been launched for sale through an expression of interest (EOI) exercise with a guide price of $110 million.
